description: Deploy Catchbook to production with professional CI/CD pipelines, containerization, multi-environment management, and AI-assisted code review. Master the infrastructure and automation needed to ship reliably and iterate quickly.
catchbook_focus: Build and deploy Catchbook's complete infrastructure: GitHub Actions CI/CD, Docker containers for backend and frontend, production deployments on Railway/Render/Fly.io and Vercel/Netlify, automated AI code review with Claude Code, and separate dev/staging/prod environments.
entry_criteria: GitHub repository configured with appropriate secrets
Claude Code CLI experience from Phases 2 and 15
exit_criteria: CI pipeline running lint, test, and build on every PR
Dockerized backend and frontend services with multi-stage builds
Backend deployed to production (Railway, Render, or Fly.io)
Frontend deployed to production (Vercel or Netlify)
Automated Claude Code review integrated into PR workflow
Separate dev, staging, and production environments configured
Cost monitoring and budget alerts for CI-based AI usage
Catchbook accessible via public URL with SSL/HTTPS

modules.catchbook_deliverable: CI pipeline with Claude Code automated code review
